title: Monthly finished encounters
definition: Number of encounters with status finished, grouped by UTC start month.
keywords: monthly encounters visits utilization count finished hospital
limitations: Months with no finished encounters are absent.

title: Monthly distinct patients
definition: Distinct patients with a finished encounter, counted once in each UTC start month.
keywords: monthly unique distinct patients people visits
limitations: A patient can appear in multiple months; summing these counts is not a distinct population count.

title: Mean encounter duration by month
definition: Mean elapsed minutes from start to end among finished encounters in each UTC start month.
keywords: mean average duration minutes encounter length monthly
limitations: Null end timestamps are excluded from the mean.
Encounter duration is not necessarily hospital length of stay.

title: Recorded condition prevalence
definition: Distinct patients with a confirmed active, recurrent, or relapsed condition divided by all loaded patients, grouped by terminology system and code. An optional filter matches the condition name.
keywords: condition prevalence common diabetes hypertension diagnosis proportion percent
limitations: This is a current recorded snapshot, not historical population prevalence.
The denominator includes all loaded patients, including deceased patients.
Unknown verification, refuted, error, and inactive conditions are excluded.
Name filters are literal substring matches, not clinical concept sets; condition groups can overlap.

FHIR Condition resources may describe social context, history, and care situations as well as clinical conditions; this metric includes them and does not identify chronic disease. Dashboard groups are a separate curated presentation mapping.

title: Medication requests by status
definition: Number of MedicationRequest resources grouped by request status; includes all statuses.
keywords: medication medications prescription prescriptions drug requests count status
limitations: Requests do not establish dispensing, administration, or adherence.
Date and drug-name filters are not supported by this assistant yet.
